families.title: Conditions and organizational regimes
families.eligibility: A declared intervention or computational scan changes a specified condition and reports a discriminating structural/order observable. Keep model ensembles separate from physical preparations; distinguish jointly changed conditions from an isolated causal intervention.
families.scopedPrediction: Within the specified comparison, the reported condition change selects distinguishable states under the stated organizational observable. This is a case-specific retrospective prediction; it assigns no universal threshold and predicts no unmeasured dynamics.

supportCriteria.text: The source reports distinct organizational readouts under the declared conditions, with preparation and observation/model boundaries retained.

contraryCriteria.text: Within an eligible matched test, the specified discriminator remains unchanged across the claimed switching range at the declared resolution. Such a result challenges that bounded prediction, not all possible condition dependence.

inconclusiveCriteria.text: Readouts are absent, conditions/constructs change together, or a model-assisted classification does not isolate the proposed physical switching mechanism.

families.overextension: A component list uniquely fixes organization, every environmental change induces a transition, or a phase label alone supplies physical kinetics.

families.title: Persistence through barriers, exchange constraints and supplied resources
families.eligibility: Specify what persists or recovers, its preparation, a perturbation/comparator if available, and a finite observation window. Separate measured durations, fitted/extrapolated rates and computational clocks. Barrier, exchange and replenishment hypotheses are different mechanisms.
families.scopedPrediction: A specified target remains detectable or recurrently operational over the reported finite horizon under the stated boundary/resource conditions; loss or altered persistence in a relevant comparison constrains its maintenance requirements. Mechanism identification requires additional controls.

supportCriteria.text: The source establishes finite retention, limited conversion, recovery or repeated operation under declared conditions, without converting non-detection or extrapolation into indefinite stability.

Data-dependent rate fits/extrapolations support a preparation-conditional kinetic persistence account with the measured input, model and uncertainty retained. This is evidence about inferred kinetics; no direct observation of the extrapolated lifetime is claimed.

contraryCriteria.text: An actually reported loss, stall or depletion contradicts the overextension from topology, structural order or individually working steps to unconditional persistent operation. Do not label missing measurements as observed loss.

inconclusiveCriteria.text: Persistence horizon is unmeasured, the relevant control is missing, a lifetime is extrapolated, or the evidence does not isolate a claimed barrier, exchange or replenishment mechanism.

families.overextension: A cycle is autonomous, every ordered structure persists indefinitely, a fitted extrapolation is an observed lifetime, or all persistence mechanisms share one numerical stability measure.

families.title: Organization-associated changes in operation
families.eligibility: Require a declared functional/response observable and a comparator. State the anticipated direction or qualitative discriminator for each case; preserve active fractions, preparation differences and possible common-environment explanations.
families.scopedPrediction: In the selected matched comparison, the declared state/arrangement change is associated with its specified response difference (including sign reversal or suppression). Spatial proximity alone cannot identify a mechanism or predict improvement.

supportCriteria.text: An actual comparison reports the named response difference under stated controls. This supports only that scoped response relation, not a unique pathway or universal benefit.

contraryCriteria.text: A measured suppressive, null or sign-changing response challenges a universal monotonic-gain extension. Do not treat a missing functional assay as a measured null.

The source reports successful individual transformations but incomplete operation when combined, challenging guaranteed composition of working steps. Keep the preparation and actual extent of failure/control review explicit.

inconclusiveCriteria.text: Only structure, partition, mobility or pair interaction is measured; the proposed functional benefit or assembly operation is not measured.
A response difference exists but alternative controls, unmatched active populations or multiple changed conditions prevent attribution to the proposed isolated mechanism.
A functional outcome is measured, but no matched organizational comparator identifies an organization-specific change or benefit. Observed operation alone is insufficient for this candidate.

families.overextension: More organization necessarily improves operation, co-localization proves substrate channeling, or partition alone demonstrates catalytic benefit.

assessments.rationale: A specified density range changes the source model organization diagnosed by declared observables; this supports a scoped computational example rather than a universal phase law.
Declared thermal protocols have different observed structural outcomes; the comparison does not identify an exact equilibrium threshold.
Persistence is bounded by stated preparation, treatment and detection windows; another treatment yields conversion.
Protocol-dependent metastability does not quantify the microscopic barrier or a kinetic law.

Measured H band loss and its source first-order fits support preparation-specific finite kinetic estimates. Deuterated non-decay is excluded from this positive assessment because its observation horizon is unspecified.

The D observation horizon is unspecified, so no numerical lower lifetime bound follows. The separate reduced WKB interpretation does not establish full-dimensional, matrix-specific dynamics reproducing all host effects.

This challenge case supplies an inferred repulsive interaction and finite null-attraction result. It does not observe a persistent assembly, so it cannot be counted as positive persistence support or universal failure of assembly.

Some classifier-defined ordered nuclei shrink under the stated preparation. This contradicts the overextension that formation of an ordered cluster guarantees its continued persistence; it does not deny larger-nucleus growth.
The surface/volume framework and interface inference are conditional on shape, classifier and statistical assumptions; they do not independently measure a universal kinetic barrier.
The declared field preparation selects distinguishable film states with polarity-sensitive readouts, within the finite source interpretation.
The short-circuit pulse-retention preparation supplies a finite no-resolved-back-switching result rather than an indefinite lifetime.

The direct transverse response is compared before/after reversal under declared loading and axis conventions and changes sign; this is neither a universal gain claim nor a quantitative bulk coefficient.
Multiple controls support state classification, but the complete atomistic causal pathway is not measured by these readouts.
Solution conditions alter the source-assigned structural population; this is a finite protein example.
Specified preparation/ligand comparisons have measured responses; evidence is bounded by construct and downstream-assay conditions.
Sequence, conformation and solution effects are not individually isolated; no universal structure-to-function rule follows.
Source-fitted rates support conditional kinetic persistence with explicit extrapolation/model limits; no centuries-long observation is claimed.
This source supports a conditional barrier account, but does not uniquely resolve all microscopic contributions or remove variant/model assumptions.
The same source construct has ligand-dependent binding and distal dynamic responses; operation here is molecular response, not catalytic performance.
The source second binding step is less favorable, providing a scoped counterexample to an assumed universally improving cooperative response.
A response is measured, while the specific microscopic communication mechanism remains underdetermined.
A specified preparation comparison has a measured finite coupled-signal difference; no isolated single-enzyme turnover or universal enhancement follows.
Control responses leave several preparation/environment mechanisms compatible with the signal.
An imposed condition series changes the observed dense/dilute organization in this preparation; hysteresis limits equilibrium claims.
Spatial partition and tracer mobility are not a measured catalytic benefit. Unmeasured outcome is not a negative effect.

The separately recorded main-text-only stepwise and combined preparations report different completion outcomes. Their full supplementary traces and controls remain unreviewed; no single redesign cause is established.
Redesign effects are not single-variable controlled and underlying failure controls remain outside review.
Only externally resourced finite 90-minute operation is supported; no unbounded persistence or catalyst replacement.
CETCH 5.4 operation is measured, but multiple changes across versions and the unread supplementary controls do not provide a matched isolation of organization as the cause of a response difference.
Observed 30-hour operation is explicitly conditional on prepared activated fragments and external replenishment.

Reciprocal ligation and supplied finite amplification are observed, but this selection does not retain a matched topology/organization comparator. Successful operation alone does not isolate an organization-specific benefit.
Actual batch growth levels off as substrates deplete, challenging the extension from reciprocal topology to resource-independent persistent amplification.
Finite cargo retention and condition-dependent exchange are supported with explicit measurement/detection bounds.
A specified membrane-composition comparison gives a measured fed-extension contrast; this is a finite assay-specific operation.

review.retrospectiveExposure: All selected publications and reported outcomes were available during source review and informed this purposive selection and protocol. No case in this pilot is a genuinely unseen prospective test. Case annotations are literature interpretations, not independent acquisition or numerical replay.
review.splitRationale: Keep each primary publication and its preparation/readout/model records in one dependency group. Use AlScN switching, the isolated colloid-pair null, all CETCH versions and all selected Mansy vesicle preparations as retrospective challenge groups; the other ten publication groups develop the comparisons. Group disjointness is a leakage check, not proof that different publications have no shared assumptions or that the selection is representative.
review.currentConclusion:
The selected cases support several bounded distinctions rather than one universal organization law. Conditions discriminate organizational regimes in particular models/preparations; retention, kinetic resistance and supplied recurrent operation have different evidential requirements; state or arrangement changes can alter measured response without demonstrating a universal efficiency gain.

Contrary and unresolved cases are central results: CETCH 1.0 does not compose from working steps into a complete recurrent turn; batch RNA amplification depletes supplied substrates; negative CAPN cooperativity limits a universal amplification interpretation; isolated colloid data do not establish long-range attraction; Ddx4 partition does not measure catalytic benefit; and cage controls do not uniquely identify substrate channeling. These distinctions motivate conditional compatibility and maintenance hypotheses, not a new physical ancestry chain.

Retrospective challenge cases expose limits of transfer: AlScN supplies a state-associated response sign change in a specific film preparation; CETCH contrasts designed topology with supplied finite operation and a reported earlier stall; vesicles separate exchange, retention and primer-extension assays; and the colloid-pair null prevents treating every interaction measurement as assembly evidence. No common numerical threshold, causal/emergence score, prospective generalization result or independently reviewed scientific conclusion follows.

Separate new-source readings of Banerjee2017, Boekhoven2015 and Drobot2018 test the operational distinctions outside the selected atlas publications. These checks retain the case-specific readout, comparator and limitations; their result-bearing titles/search exposure and retrospective target selection prevent a blind prospective validation claim. Full review records remain outside canonical physical-claim admission.

transferChecks.question: Does an actually measured organized target persist or recover within an explicit supplied-resource boundary and finite observation horizon, with resource variation or replenishment providing an observed discriminator?
transferChecks.expectedDiscriminator: The question and criterion were assigned before full-text reading: a declared physical property has finite measured trajectories, and resource-dose, exhaustion or renewed-supply comparisons distinguish its maintenance or recovery. This does not predict an identical mechanism, threshold or timescale across cases.
transferChecks.contraryOutcome: An eligible source-specific claim of maintenance fails within its stated supply conditions, or its predicted resource discriminator produces no corresponding difference in an eligible controlled comparison. Missing duration, unread controls or an unisolated microscopic mechanism remain inconclusive.
